name: Camp Hochelaga
description_short: YWCA Vermont's inclusive girls+ camp in South Hero, VT, with overnight camp, day camp, a one-week day/overnight Mini-Camp, and a 5-week Counselor in Training program. Cabins have no electricity or WiFi. Day campers can ride a camp bus and sleep over once a week.
special_needs_notes: The camp describes itself as inclusive for girls+. Its youngest cabin group includes a cabin accessible to mobility devices. Cabins have no electricity.

warnings: Today is 2026-10-13. The only calendar on the page is for the 2026 season, which is over. The page says the 2027 calendar 'will be available soon.'

The 2026 Day Camp season (June 15 - August 14) and Overnight Camp season (June 21 - August 14) are shown only as overall date ranges. Individual weeks or sessions are not listed, so they are not recorded as sessions.

Ages and grades differ by program: Overnight is age 7+ and/or rising 2nd-12th grade. Day Camp is rising 1st to rising 11th grade. Mini-Camp is rising 2nd-6th grade. Starting in 2027, CIT is for rising 12th graders.
The registration info shown is for 2026 (opened Dec 15, 2025 for returning households and Jan 5, 2026 for new households). The portal link is currently unavailable.
